item.title: Operational Blind Spot: MOH Must Own Its HR Execution Failure — Dr Musa Mohd Nordin & Dr Zulkifli Ismail
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Blaming only MOH for health worker shortages caused by MOHE, JPA, and MOF is indeed unfair. But MOH can't be absolved either. Without fixing how we deploy, support, and retain our people, no amount of upstream policy reform will translate into better care. item.title: After DG’s Admission, Hartal Demands Health Service Commission
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
In endorsing DG Mahathar's rare acknowledgment of a fragmented health workforce pipeline, Hartal Doktor Kontrak wants a Health Service Commission to streamline the whole process, decentralise health service employment from JPA, and ensure permanent posts.
